_comment: Licenses of the third-party components that the inventory script cannot read from the component itself.
Names and versions are extracted by .github/scripts/third_party_inventory.py: never write them here.
Each entry applies to the components of the same kind whose name matches the pattern (fnmatch, case-sensitive); the first match wins, so specific entries go before generic ones.
Unity packages: the license read from the LICENSE file of the package takes precedence.
Not listed in the inventory: built-in Unity packages (identified by the Unity Editor version) and tools preinstalled on the runners (identified by the runner image).
